summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of Life Upgrade AI 2.0. Verified landing → 11-step assessment (goal, areas, ratings, obstacle, consistency + 6 deep-dive steps with radio/text/textarea/multi fields) → dashboard. All 15 requested test criteria pass. Score math is correct (avg*10 rounded), Back button works from any step, Continue is disabled with empty required fields, Generate button appears only on the last step, dashboard renders life score ring, top opportunities, biggest obstacle, 3 life-twin insights, next best action (what/when/how/why) with mark-complete flow (0/1→1/1, streak 1 Day), 6 inline expandable area cards with friction chips + dimension risk + subaction + 3 curated sources (type/cost/checked-date meta + source-note), 7-signal risk radar (goal/burnout/wellness/career/money/learning/productivity) each with level badge and why/response, Future Self section with 3 scenarios and current-score lede. Reload restores dashboard from localStorage. Start-over clears state and returns to landing. No console errors observed. Responsive check at 1920x1080 and 375x812 OK.
critical_code_review_comments: storage.js is minimal and correct; clearState only removes STORAGE_KEY (any residual localStorage entries observed after reset are from React dev tooling, not app state).
blankAssessment pre-selects all 6 areas by default — total step count is always 11 on a fresh start, matching the spec.
isDeepDiveComplete correctly treats textarea/multi and resume/notes as optional; required radios/text fields properly gate the Continue button.
Dashboard.jsx is 361 lines with 10 sub-components — consider splitting into per-panel files as it grows (>700 line rule not yet violated).
All interactive elements have stable data-testid attributes; excellent test surface.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is frontend-only, no backend. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env for the app URL. To set range slider values in Playwright, use the React native setter workaround: Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set + dispatch 'input' event (page.fill does not work on range inputs with controlled React state). All 6 areas are preselected by default (blankAssessment), so total assessment steps = 11. Deep-dive completion allows optional textarea/multi/resume/notes fields.
